title.narrative: COMBATING NONCOMMUNICABLE DISEASES THROUGH IMPROVING QUALITY OF HEALTH SERVICES IN SURINAME

description.narrative:
The goal of the project is to contribute to the reduction of premature mortality from noncommunicable diseases by one-third by 2030, in line with SDG 3.4. The main objective of the project is to reduce the morbidity and mortality related to noncommunicable diseases (NCDs) in Suriname by strengthening the institutional and human resource capacity of the public health system and hospitals to deliver comprehensive prevention, treatment, and management strategies, thereby improving population health outcomes and healthcare quality.
The project directly addresses the problem of inadequate healthcare infrastructure by providing modern facilities that can accommodate the growing healthcare needs of the population. The new hospital will not only expand the capacity for patient care but also introduce advanced medical technologies and services that are currently unavailable or insufficient in the country.
Specific objectives of the project include:
